 In Australia there is a 50% capital gain tax (CGT) discount if you hold them (after claiming) for 12 months.    Swapping from one token to another is a CGT event in Australia, so swapping now will be a small tax loss for me, which is good.

 If i swap  now, and  rise jumps to $0.5 in six months and I sell then, my tax burden will be higher (no 50% discount for holding for 12 months).

If I wait 6 months and rise jumps to $0.5 then migrate and sell,  I will still lose the CGT discount as there will be no price for copi (only rise price will be quoted on markets.) Reward Percentage is the percentage of the Daily Reward Pool awarded to the Node.  The Reward Share is the percentage of that reward that you receive.
